idf_component_register(
    SRCS "timezone.c" "tz_geo.c" "tz_geo_embedded.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
    REQUIRES time_sync pthread
)
# The coordinate -> zone map (generated by tools/gen_tz_geo.py, never
# hand-edited; tests/test_tz_geo.py). Not EMBED_FILES: PlatformIO mis-resolves
# the generated .S path (see components/sched_runner/CMakeLists.txt), so
# tz_geo_embedded.c .incbin's the checked-in file by absolute path and is
# rebuilt whenever it changes.
set(TZ_GEO_BIN "${COMPONENT_DIR}/tz_geo.bin")
target_compile_definitions(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE TZ_GEO_BIN_PATH="${TZ_GEO_BIN}")
set_property(SOURCE "${COMPONENT_DIR}/tz_geo_embedded.c" APPEND PROPERTY OBJECT_DEPENDS "${TZ_GEO_BIN}")
